label: Protective role of rosmarinic acid against radiation-induced dermatitis: focus on oxidative stress and inflammation.
summary: This study investigated the potential protective role of rosmarinic acid (RA) against oxidative stress, inflammation, and fibrosis induced by ionizing radiation in an experimental rat model. A total of 42 male Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly divided into seven groups (n = 6): G0, G1(14), G1(28), G2(14), G2(28), G3(14), and G3(28).
